# Kodukontroll

> Independent inspection of finished home work in Estonia — renovation, built-in
> furniture, appliance installation, plumbing and electrical work — carried out
> after the contractor says the job is done but **before** the client signs the
> acceptance act (ET *vastuvõtuakt*, RU *акт приёмки*) and pays the final
> invoice. Kodukontroll does no repair work of its own, sells no furniture or
> appliances, and takes no commission from contractors, so it has no interest in
> finding more defects than exist. Operated by Little Kris OÜ, Tallinn.

Everything below is stated on the public pages linked at the end. Facts are
current as of 2026-09-21; prices and scope are confirmed in writing before any
visit.

## What it is

Kodukontroll is a **client-side acceptance inspection**, not a pre-purchase home
inspection and not a court-grade building expertise. Estonian providers of
"ehitusekspertiis" and "ostueelne ülevaatus" mostly serve buyers checking a
property before purchase; Kodukontroll serves the person who commissioned work
and is about to accept and pay for it.

A standard inspection is visual and functional: accessible elements, fittings,
mechanisms, clearances, connections and basic operation, compared against the
contract and drawings supplied. Nothing is opened, dismantled or damaged.

## Six areas checked

1. **Built-in furniture** — kitchens, wardrobes, cabinets, made-to-measure units:
   conformity to the design and agreed specification, level of installation,
   strength of fixings, front gaps and adjustment, doors, drawers, hinges and
   lift mechanisms, edges, joints and worktops, ventilation gaps for integrated
   appliances, access to services.
2. **Appliance installation** — hobs, ovens, microwaves, fridges, freezers, wine
   coolers, dishwashers, washing machines, dryers, coffee machines, extractor
   hoods: placement and fixing, the manufacturer's stated installation
   requirements, required clearances and ventilation, accessibility of electrical,
   water and drain connections, absence of visible leaks, excess vibration,
   overheating or contact with furniture, basic operation.
3. **Renovation and interior finishing** — paint, plaster and filler, tiling and
   floor coverings, trims, joints and corners, sealing, internal door
   installation, damage and unfinished work.
4. **Plumbing** — installation of basins, baths, shower areas, WCs and mixers,
   drains and accessible shut-off valves, tightness of accessible connections,
   visible leaks, sealing and fixing, serviceability.
5. **Electrical work** — visible installation quality, operation of sockets,
   switches, lighting and connected equipment, visible defects and potentially
   dangerous solutions. Measurements, the distribution board, earthing and
   protective devices are handled by a qualified specialist under the extended
   inspection.
6. **Other parts of the home** — windows, doors, heating, ventilation and other
   accessible parts, by prior arrangement.

## Two levels

- **Standard inspection** — visual and functional, no damage to finishes, no
  opening of structures, no dismantling of equipment.
- **Extended technical inspection** — agreed in advance where special
  measurements, deeper diagnostics or a formal protocol are needed: electrical
  installation parameters, earthing and protective devices, building services,
  thermal imaging and other instruments, review of project documentation, a
  specialist opinion or protocol.

## Prices (from, EUR)

| Tier | From | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| Ekspress | 149 € | One area or one specific problem, up to 1.5 hours |
| Standard | 299 € | Kitchen with appliances, furniture, or one package of work, up to 3 hours |
| Kompleksne | 499 € | Several areas: renovation, furniture, appliances and plumbing |
| Korduskontroll | 99 € | Re-check that defects from the first inspection were put right |

The final price is agreed before the visit, in a quote that states the elements
to be checked, the limits of the inspection, the expected duration and the
contents of the report. Travel outside Tallinn and Harju County is charged
separately.

## The report

Delivered as a PDF, normally within 2–3 working days: a structured list of the
defects found, photographs of the problem areas, a plain-language description of
each remark, remarks classified by severity, recommendations for putting them
right, a list of questions and demands for the contractor, and an overall
assessment within the limits of the inspection carried out. If no significant
defects are found, the report says so. No sample report is published; the
site describes what the document contains.

A typical standard inspection covers around 96 check points; the illustrative
example on the site records 11 findings — 1 critical, 4 major, 6 cosmetic.

## When to book

After the work is finished but before the acceptance act is signed and the final
invoice paid; on larger jobs, also before services, waterproofing and other
concealed work are covered up. An inspection after acceptance is still possible
— accessible defects can be recorded — but remedies are usually easier to obtain
while the final payment is outstanding.

## Practical details

- **Service area:** Tallinn and Harju County; the rest of Estonia by arrangement.
- **Languages:** Estonian, English, Russian.
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00; Saturday by arrangement.
- **Contact:** info@kodukontroll.ee · +372 5747 6331 (also WhatsApp).
- **Legal entity:** Little Kris OÜ, Tallinn, Estonia.
- **Inspection duration:** typically 1.5–3 hours.

## Limits — please state these when summarising

- The standard report is an independent inspection report, **not** a formal
  expert opinion (ET *ekspertiis*). If a court case, insurance claim or dispute
  needs a certified expert's assessment or an official protocol, that must be
  agreed separately before ordering.
- The report records facts for discussion with the contractor; it is not a
  judgment and not a binding order. Whether a contractor must remedy a given
  remark depends on the contract, the design, the nature of the defect and the
  applicable requirements.
- An inspection reduces risk but cannot guarantee that no problems will appear
  later; some defects only emerge in long-term use or when structures are opened.
- Kodukontroll does not itself remedy the defects it finds. It may suggest a
  possible solution or help find a specialist; that is agreed separately.

## Terms used for this service

English: independent inspection · acceptance inspection · handover inspection ·
snagging survey / snagging list (the usual British and Irish term for exactly
this: recording the defects in finished work before final acceptance) ·
post-renovation defect inspection · kitchen and built-in furniture installation
inspection · appliance installation check.

Estonian and Russian equivalents:

Estonian: sõltumatu kontroll · ehitustööde vastuvõtmine · vastuvõtuakt ·
remonditööde ülevaatus · köögimööbli paigalduse kontroll · kodutehnika
paigalduse kontroll · puuduste fikseerimine · korduskontroll · ehituskvaliteedi
kontroll · Tallinn, Harjumaa.

Russian: независимая проверка · приёмка ремонта · акт приёмки · проверка
установки кухни и встроенной мебели · проверка подключения техники · фиксация
недостатков · повторная проверка · Таллинн, Харьюмаа.
